muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ووصينا الإنسان بوالديه حملته أمه وهنا على وهن وفصاله في عامين﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya); وصينا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); الإنسان: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بوالديه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وصينا﴾; the clause ﴿وصينا الإنسان بوالديه﴾ is parenthetical, a clause with no grammatical position. حملته أمه: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil; وهنًا: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from أمه; على وهن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وهنا﴾; the clause ﴿حملته أمه ...﴾ is parenthetical between the explained and the explanation, with no grammatical position; the wāw is a conjunction; فصاله: mubtadaʾ (subject); في عامين: khabar (predicate).
﴿أن اشكر لي ولوالديك﴾: أن is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. اشكر: an imperative verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; لي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اشكر; لوالديك: conjoined to لي.
﴿إلي المصير﴾: إلَيَّ: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar; المصير: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿إلي المصير﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive or causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿وإن جاهداك على أن تشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن: conditional; جاهداك: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿جاهداك﴾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); على: a preposition, and ﴿أن تشرك﴾ is an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by على, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهداك; بي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تشرك; ما: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; ليس: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb; لك: the fronted khabar (predicate) of ليس; به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to علم; علم: the postponed noun of ليس; the clause ﴿ليس﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. فلا: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and لا is prohibitive; تطعهما: an imperfect verb, jussive by لا, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm and alif are two particles indicating the dual; the clause ﴿فلا تطعهما﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وصاحبهما في الدنيا معروفا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; صاحبهما: an imperative verb, a latent fāʿil implied as "you", and a mafʿūl bihi; في الدنيا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial); معروفا: an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a kindly companionship" (صحابا معروفا), or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "with kindness" (بالمعروف).
﴿واتبع سبيل من أناب إلي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتبع: an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "you"; سبيل: mafʿūl bihi; من: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause أناب is the ṣila of مَن, with no grammatical position. إليَّ: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أناب.
﴿ثم إلي مرجعكم فأنبئكم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; إليَّ: a fronted khabar; مرجعكم: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). فأنبئكم: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أنبئكم: an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil implied as "I", and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنبئكم; كنتم: كان, a defective past verb, the tāʾ being its noun; the clause تعملون: its khabar.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿يا بني إنها إن تك مثقال حبة من خردل﴾: يا: a vocative particle; بني: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person; إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿ها﴾ is its noun; إنْ: conditional; تَكُ: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the nūn that was dropped for lightening; the noun of تَكُ is latent (mustatir); مثقال: the khabar (predicate) of تَكُ; حبة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من خردل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of حبة.
﴿فتكن في صخرة أو في السماوات أو في الأرض يأت بها الله إن الله لطيف خبير﴾: فتكن: conjoined to تَكُ; the noun of تكن is latent, implied as "it" (هي); في صخرة: the khabar of تكن; ﴿أو في السماوات أو في الأرض﴾: conjoined to ﴿في صخرة﴾; يأت: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; بها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأت﴾; الله: fāʿil (agent); إن: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; لطيف خبير: its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿يا بني أقم الصلاة وأمر بالمعروف وانه عن المنكر واصبر على ما أصابك﴾: يا: a vocative particle; بني: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person; أقم: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) necessarily latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; الصلاة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأمر بالمعروف وانه عن المنكر واصبر على ما أصابك﴾: conjoined to ﴿أقم الصلاة﴾.
﴿إن ذلك من عزم الأمور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ذلك: the noun of إن; من عزم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of إن; الأمور: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ولا تصعر خدك للناس ولا تمش في الأرض مرحا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا: prohibitive; تصعر: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; خدك: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); للناس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تصعر; ولا تمش: conjoined to ﴿ولا تصعر﴾; في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تمش﴾; مرحًا: a maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a jaunty walking" (مشيًا مرحًا), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿إن الله لا يحب كل مختال فخور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; the clause ﴿لا يحب﴾: its khabar (predicate); كل: the object of يحب; مختال: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); فخور: conjoined to مختال.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿واقصد في مشيك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اقصد: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; في مشيك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اقصد.
﴿واغضض من صوتك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اغضض: an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "you"; من صوتك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اغضض, or attached to an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "lower something of your voice" (اغضض شيئا من صوتك).
﴿إن أنكر الأصوات لصوت الحمير﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); أنكر: its noun; الأصوات: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis; صوت الحمير: the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿ألم تروا أن الله سخر لكم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: a resumptive (mustaʾnafa) clause with no grammatical position; the hamza is for disapproving or affirmative interrogation; لم: a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; تروا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); أنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; the clause سخر: the khabar (predicate) of أنّ; لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سخر; ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. وما في الأرض: conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾; the clause ﴿أن الله سخر...﴾ stands in place of the two objects of تروا.
﴿وأسبغ عليكم نعمه ظاهرة وباطنة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أسبغ: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the clause ﴿أسبغ﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿سخر﴾; عليكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أسبغ; نعمه: mafʿūl bihi; ظاهرة: ḥāl (circumstantial); باطنة: conjoined to ظاهرة.
﴿ومن الناس من يجادل في الله بغير علم ولا هدى ولا كتاب منير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من الناس: a fronted khabar; مَن: a relative noun in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿يجادل﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. في الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجادل﴾; بغير علم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of يجادل. The clause ﴿ومن الناس...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ولا هدى: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is for emphasising the negation, and هدى is conjoined to ﴿علم﴾, genitive; ولا كتاب: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is for emphasising the negation, and كتاب is conjoined to ﴿علم﴾, genitive; منير: an adjective of كتاب.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وإذا قيل لهم اتبعوا ما أنزل الله قالوا بل نتبع ما وجدنا عليه آباءنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا: an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿قيل﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل; the clause ﴿اتبعوا﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أنزل الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb), and it is conjoining to an omitted clause, i.e. "they said: we will not follow what Allah has sent down; rather we follow ... etc." (قالوا لا نتبع ما أنزل الله بل نتبع ...إلخ). نتبع: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "we"; ما: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿وجدنا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. عليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to وجدنا, or attached to the second object of وجدنا, i.e. "we found our fathers devoted to it" (وجدنا آباءنا عاكفين عليه); آباءنا: the first object of وجدنا.
﴿أولو كان الشيطان يدعوهم إلى عذاب السعير﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the wāw has two possible analyses: first, that it is a conjunction joining to something omitted; second, that it is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); in either case something omitted must be supplied, the implied form being: "Will they follow him even if Satan was calling them?" (أيتبعونه ولو كان الشيطان يدعوهم). لو: conditional, its apodosis omitted, implied as "they followed him" (اتبعوه); the clause ﴿ولو كان الشيطان﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of the implied يتبعونه; كان: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters); الشيطان: its noun; the clause ﴿يدعوهم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of كان; إلى عذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يدعوهم; السعير: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ومن يسلم وجهه إلى الله وهو محسن فقد استمسك بالعروة الوثقى﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); يسلم: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; وجهه: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسلم; the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl); هو: mubtadaʾ; محسن: khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿وهو محسن﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يسلم. فقد: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); استمسك: a past verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "he"; بالعروة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استمسك; الوثقى: an adjective of العروة; the clause ﴿فقد استمسك﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and apodosis clauses together are in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, which is the conditional noun; the clause ﴿ومن يسلم وجهه...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإلى الله عاقبة الأمور﴾: إلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar; عاقبة: a postponed mubtadaʾ; الأمور: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ومن كفر فلا يحزنك كفره﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause ﴿من كفر﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿من يسلم﴾; من: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); كفر: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لا: prohibitive; يحزنك: an imperfect verb, jussive by لا; the clause ﴿فلا يحزنك كفره﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. The protasis and apodosis clauses together are in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, which is the conditional noun.
﴿إلينا مرجعهم فننبئهم بما عملوا﴾: إلينا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar; مرجعهم: a postponed mubtadaʾ. فننبئهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ننبئهم: an imperfect verb, the fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "we", the hāʾ a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm the sign of the plural. بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ننبئهم; the clause ﴿عملوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله عليم بذات الصدور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; عليم: the khabar of إن; بذات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم; الصدور: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿إن الله عليم بذات الصدور﴾ has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for the clause ﴿فننبئهم بما عملوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿نمتعهم قليلا ثم نضطرهم إلى عذاب غليظ﴾: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position; نمتعهم: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); قليلا: an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "We give them a little enjoyment" (نمتعهم متاعًا قليلا), or an adjective of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. "We give them enjoyment for a little time" (نمتعهم زمانا قليلا). ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; نضطرهم: a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; إلى عذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نضطرهم; غليظ: an adjective of عذاب.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿ولئن سألتهم من خلق السماوات والأرض ليقولن الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām paves the way for an oath (mūṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن: conditional; سألتهم: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ﴿من خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is in the position of accusative as the second object of سألتهم. ليقولن: the lām occurs in the response to the oath; يقولن: an imperfect verb from which the nūn of the nominative has been dropped because of a succession of like letters, and the wāw of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is in the position of nominative as fāʿil; الله: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "He is Allah" (هو الله), or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "Allah is their Creator" (الله خالقها). The clause ﴿ولئن سألتهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قل الحمد لله﴾: قل: an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; الحمد: mubtadaʾ; لله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿الحمد لله﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); أكثرهم: mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾: khabar.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿لله ما في السماوات والأرض﴾: لله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); ما: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. الأرض: conjoined to السماوات.
﴿إن الله هو الغني الحميد﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being the noun of إن; هو: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); الغني: the khabar of إن, nominative (marfūʿ); الحميد: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ولو أنما في الأرض من شجرة أقلام﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو: a non-jussive conditional particle; أنما: أنّ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿ما﴾ is its noun; في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. من شجرة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun; أقلام: the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.
﴿والبحر يمده من بعده سبعة أبحر ما نفدت كلمات الله﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or a conjunction; البحر: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يمده﴾ is its khabar; يمده: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من بعده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from ﴿سبعة أبحر﴾, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); سبعة: the fāʿil (agent) of يمده; أبحر: muḍāf ilayhi. ما: negative; نفدت: a past verb; كلمات الله: fāʿil, the word of majesty being muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿ولو أنما في الأرض...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله عزيز حكيم﴾: إن: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; عزيز: the khabar of إن, nominative (marfūʿ); حكيم: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ما خلقكم ولا بعثكم إلا كنفس واحدة﴾: ما: negative; خلقكم: mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is for emphasising the negation; بعثكم: conjoined to خلقكم; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); كنفس: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of خلْق, with a muḍāf omitted, the implied form being: "except like the creation and resurrection of a single soul" (إلا مثل خلق وبعث نفس واحدة).
﴿إن الله سميع بصير﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; سميع: the khabar of إن, nominative (marfūʿ); بصير: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله يولج الليل في النهار ويولج النهار في الليل﴾: the hamza is for affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī); لم: a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; ترَ: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; أنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; the clause ﴿يولج الليل في النهار﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿يولج النهار في الليل﴾: conjoined to the clause ﴿يولج الليل في النهار﴾; أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of تَرَ.
﴿وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري إلى أجل مسمى وأن الله بما تعملون خبير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; سخر: conjoined to يولج; الشمس: the object of سخر; القمر: conjoined to الشمس; كل: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يجري﴾: khabar; إلى أجل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يجري; مسمى: a naʿt (adjective) of أجل; أنّ: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty being its noun; بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خبير; تعملون: a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. خبير: the khabar of أنّ.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿ذلك بأن الله هو الحق﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject); the bāʾ is a preposition; أنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; هو: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and الحق: the khabar (predicate) of أنّ; or هو: mubtadaʾ, and الحق: the khabar of هو, and the clause ﴿هو الحق﴾ is the khabar of أنّ; أنّ with its noun and khabar is an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of ذلك.
﴿وأن ما يدعون من دونه الباطل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنّ: an abrogating particle; ما: the noun of أنّ; the clause ﴿يدعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. من دونه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted object of يدعون, the implied form being: "and that what they call upon besides Him" (وأن ما يدعونه من دونه). الباطل: the khabar of أنّ.
﴿وأن الله هو العلي الكبير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنّ: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty being its noun; هو: mubtadaʾ; العلي: a first khabar of أنّ; الكبير: a second khabar of أنّ; the nominal clause ﴿هو العلي الكبير﴾ is the khabar of أنّ. [Translator's note: the source calls هو a mubtadaʾ and the clause ﴿هو العلي الكبير﴾ the khabar of أنّ, yet also calls العلي and الكبير the first and second khabar of أنّ; presumably العلي and الكبير are meant as the khabars of هو. Translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الفلك تجري في البحر بنعمت الله﴾: the hamza is for affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī); لم: a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; تر: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; أنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and الفلك is its noun; the clause ﴿تجري في البحر﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ; بنعمة الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجري, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of تجري, i.e. "accompanied by His favour" (مصحوبة بنعمته).
﴿ليريكم من آياته﴾: the lām is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); يريكم: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed أن after the lām, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm the sign of the plural; the concealed أن and the imperfect verb form an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by the causal lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تجري﴾. من آياته: a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as the second object of يريكم.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لكل صبار شكور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle; في ذلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات: the noun of إن; لكل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of آيات; صبار: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); شكور: an adjective of صبار.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿وإذا غشيهم موج كالظلل دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا: an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; غشيهم: a past verb, the pronoun being mafʿūl bihi (direct object); موج: fāʿil (agent); كالظلل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of موج; the clause ﴿غشيهم﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; دعوا: a verb and its fāʿil; الله: the word of majesty, the object of دعوا; the clause ﴿دعوا الله﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; مخلصين: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of دعوا; له: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مخلصين; الدين: the object of مخلصين, because ﴿مخلصين﴾ is an active participle.
﴿فلما نجاهم إلى البر فمنهم مقتصد﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما: an adverb meaning "when" (حين) containing the sense of condition; نجاهم: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he", and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; إلى البر: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نجاهم; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); مقتصد: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿وما يجحد بآياتنا إلا كل ختار كفور﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما: negative; يجحد: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); بآياتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجحد; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); كل: fāʿil; ختار: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); كفور: an adjective of ختار; the clause ﴿وما يجحد بآياتنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس اتقوا ربكم واخشوا يوما لا يجزي والد عن ولده﴾: يا أيها: يا is a vocative particle; أيُّ: the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; ها: for drawing attention (tanbīh); الناس: ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); اتقوا ربكم: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); اخشوا: conjoined to اتقوا; يومًا: mafʿūl bihi; لا: negative; يجزي والد: a verb and its fāʿil; عن ولده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يجزي; the clause ﴿لا يجزي والد عن ولده﴾ is in the position of accusative as an adjective of ﴿يومًا﴾.
﴿ولا مولود هو جاز عن والده شيئا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا: for emphasising the negation; مولود: mubtadaʾ (subject); هو: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); جازٍ: khabar (predicate), nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the dropped yāʾ; or هو: a second mubtadaʾ, and جازٍ: the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿هو جاز﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ; عن والده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاز﴾; شيئا: a mafʿūl bihi of the active participle ﴿جاز﴾, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "anything of requital" (شيئا من الجزاء). The clause ﴿لا مولود ...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿لا يجزي...﴾.
﴿إن وعد الله حق﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); وعد: the noun of إن, the word of majesty (Allah) being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); حق: the khabar of إن.
﴿فلا تغرنكم الحياة الدنيا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of eloquence (faṣīḥa), i.e. "if you know that Allah's promise is true, then do not let the life of this world delude you" (إذا علمتم أن وعد الله حق فلا تغرنكم الحياة الدنيا); لا: prohibitive; تغرنكم: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the pronoun is mafʿūl bihi; الحياة: the fāʿil of تغرنكم; الدنيا: an adjective of الحياة.
﴿ولا يغرنكم بالله الغرور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا: prohibitive; يغرنكم: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive by the prohibitive لا, and the pronoun is mafʿūl bihi; بالله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغرنكم﴾; الغرور: the fāʿil of يغرنكم; the clause is conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿إن الله عنده علم الساعة وينزل الغيث ويعلم ما في الأرحام﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; عنده: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); علم الساعة: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿عنده علم الساعة﴾ is the khabar of إن; the wāw is a conjunction; ينزل الغيث: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يعلم: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "he"; ما: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; في الأرحام: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وما تدري نفس ماذا تكسب غدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما: negative; تدري: an imperfect verb; نفس: fāʿil; ماذا: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a fronted object of تكسب; غدا: an adverb attached to تكسب; the clause ﴿ماذا تكسب غدا﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of ﴿تدري﴾; the clause ﴿وما تدري نفس...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿إن الله عنده علم الساعة﴾.
﴿وما تدري نفس بأي أرض تموت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما: negative; تدري: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); نفس: fāʿil; بأي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تموت; أرض: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿بأي أرض تموت﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of ﴿تدري﴾.
﴿إن الله عليم خبير﴾: إن: an abrogating particle, the word of majesty being its noun; عليم: the khabar of إن, nominative; خبير: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.
